minecraft:written_book_content.title: Distant Memory
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Minecraft
pages: Tales are told of a great Library, hidden in long-lost strongholds of the world. These libraries contained powerful books of words so strong they imbue unimaginable power into those that wield them. It is said that these Libraries were filled with the knowledge of times
long since past, but now, the once-mighty Strongholds and their libraries have since vanished into the depths of the past, reduced to nothing but a distant memory.
